messages:
ashwin: FYI — we're flipping the runtime kernel change + new batching heuristic (kernel v2.3) in prod tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. This touches runtime, router, and console route metrics. Need pins & rollback plan. Can API & router teams confirm compat?

maria: noted. API team will pin v2026.3 for 4 hours around the window. We'll keep canary at 10% for first 20m.

sam: Router: we need a handshake update to ensure KV cache keys still match after kernel switch. I'll add a runtime compatibility header check. If mismatch, router returns 409 and falls back to older route. ETA 3pm PT.

ashwin: perfect. Planning: steps — 1) preflight smoke on staging 01:00 UTC 2) push kernel to one runtime shard 3) monitor latency & token p50/99 4) promote 50% -> 100% if stable 5) rollback plan. Anyone want to tweak?

kim: console UX: we should freeze config changes during window. I'll put a hold in the console and add a banner. Also push release notes that mention transient model pinning.

dana: oncall - set SLO alert thresholds to +2x for p99 during rollout and add paging. I'll add incident channel #incidents/rolling-kernel.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled by ashwin at 1998080000. Preflight checks: runtime-health OK, router-schema OK, API-key sync OK.

maria: small note: embeddings endpoints will be routed to quantized variant if latency spikes. Please ensure fallback route exists.

sam: added header `X-Runtime-Kernel: v2.3` and router will check before routing. If header absent, router will route to pinned-old runtime. snippet:
```
if headers['X-Runtime-Kernel'] != 'v2.3':
  route = 'runtime-v1'
else:
  route = 'runtime-v2'
```

ashwin: rollback criteria: any sustained p99 increase > 40% for 5m OR error rate > 1% -> immediate rollback to kernel v2.2 and unpin router. Confirmed?

maria: confirmed. We'll pin API to v2026.3 and have toggles to unpin automatically on rollback.

kim: adding a postmortem template in case. Also saving a snapshot of console configs.

ashwin: thanks all. I'll post final checklist 1h before window. :rocket:
